useful_god.rationale: Day Master Fire is weak; Wood balances the chart.

deprecated.lines.relationship: since engine 1.1.0; use love_money (love, mid, money)

yogas.name: Gaja-Kesari
yogas.reason: Jupiter is in the 8th sign from the Moon; Gaja-Kesari needs the 1st, 4th, 7th or 10th.

yogas.name: Budha-Aditya
yogas.reason: Sun is in Capricorn and Mercury in Sagittarius; Budha-Aditya needs both in the same sign.

yogas.name: Chandra-Mangala
yogas.reason: Moon is in Taurus and Mars in Pisces; Chandra-Mangala needs both in the same sign.

yogas.name: Ruchaka
yogas.reason: Mars is in Pisces, neither its own sign (Aries, Scorpio) nor its exaltation sign (Capricorn).

yogas.name: Bhadra
yogas.reason: Mercury is in Sagittarius, neither its own sign (Gemini, Virgo) nor its exaltation sign (Virgo).

yogas.name: Hamsa
yogas.reason: Jupiter is in its own sign Sagittarius but in the 11th house from the Lagna; Hamsa needs a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th or 10th house).

yogas.name: Malavya
yogas.reason: Venus is in Aquarius, neither its own sign (Taurus, Libra) nor its exaltation sign (Pisces).

yogas.name: Sasa
yogas.reason: Saturn is in Taurus, neither its own sign (Capricorn, Aquarius) nor its exaltation sign (Libra).

yogas.name: Harsha
yogas.reason: The 6th house is Cancer; its lord Moon is in the 4th house; Harsha needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Sarala
yogas.reason: The 8th house is Virgo; its lord Mercury is in the 11th house; Sarala needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Vimala
yogas.reason: The 12th house is Capricorn; its lord Saturn is in the 4th house; Vimala needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Neecha Bhanga
yogas.reason: No planet is in its debilitation sign.

yogas.name: Sunapha
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Gemini): none; 12th from the Moon (Aries): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Anapha
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Gemini): none; 12th from the Moon (Aries): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Durudhara
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Gemini): none; 12th from the Moon (Aries): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Kemadruma
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Gemini): none; 12th from the Moon (Aries): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count); Kemadruma means both are empty. It is cancelled (Kemadruma Bhanga): Venus and Saturn in a kendra from the Moon (1st, 4th, 7th or 10th sign).

yogas.name: Vesi
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Aquarius): Venus; 12th from the Sun (Sagittarius): Mercury and Jupiter (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Vasi
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Aquarius): Venus; 12th from the Sun (Sagittarius): Mercury and Jupiter (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Ubhayachari
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Aquarius): Venus; 12th from the Sun (Sagittarius): Mercury and Jupiter (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Subha Kartari
yogas.reason: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in the 2nd house: none; in the 12th: none. Subha Kartari needs both houses occupied by them (the Moon is not counted).

yogas.name: Papa Kartari
yogas.reason: Natural malefics (Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu) in the 2nd house: Mars; in the 12th: Sun and Rahu. Papa Kartari needs both houses occupied by them (the Moon is not counted).

yogas.name: Parivartana
yogas.reason: Venus is in Aquarius (ruled by Saturn) and Saturn is in Taurus (ruled by Venus).

yogas.name: Mangal Dosha
yogas.reason: Mars is 2nd from the Lagna, 11th from the Moon and 2nd from Venus; the dosha houses are the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th and 12th.

yogas.name: Kala Sarpa
yogas.reason: Planets lie on both sides of the Rahu–Ketu axis: Sun, Moon, Mars, Venus and Saturn on one, Mercury and Jupiter on the other.

yogas.name: Amala
yogas.reason: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in the 10th from the Lagna (Scorpio): none; in the 10th from the Moon (Aquarius): Venus.

yogas.name: Dhana
yogas.reason: The 2nd lord Jupiter and the 5th lord Mercury are linked: Jupiter and Mercury are both in Sagittarius.

yogas.name: Dharma-Karmadhipati
yogas.reason: The 9th lord Venus (Aquarius) and the 10th lord Mars (Pisces) share no sign, mutual aspect or sign exchange.

yogas.name: Nakshatra Parivartana
yogas.reason: No two bodies occupy each other's nakshatras; nakshatra lords: Sun Moon, Moon Moon, Mars Mercury, Mercury Sun, Jupiter Ketu, Venus Rahu, Saturn Sun, Rahu Moon, Ketu Saturn.
